messages:
Elsa: quick heads-up from a customer session — on narrow phones the left-edge sidebar handle overlaps the table row overflow chevron. Users tap the chevron and open the sidebar accidentally. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/ux/chevron-handle-collision.png :confused:
Marco: repro steps? device/UA?
Elsa: Pixel 3a & older iPhones, viewport ~360px. Table has long ids with horizontal scroll; chevron lives ~18px from edge and handle sits over it.
Sam: metrics show small uptick in mobile "open row" abandonment for that cohort. Likely same issue.
June: accessibility: overlapping controls cause confusing focus order and TalkBack/VoiceOver reads the wrong element. Also handle contrast low in dark mode.
Marco: two quick fixes: (1) reduce visible handle to 6-8px but keep a 44x44 hit area via pseudo-element, (2) detect horizontal-scroll containers and shift chevrons left by 20px when present.
Elsa: prefer (1) + small chevron nudge. Also change mobile action copy from "Details" -> "Open panel" for clarity.
June: if handle shrinks ensure it has aria-label="Open sidebar" and an offscreen focusable control in header for keyboard users. Update screen reader text for chevron to "Show row actions".
Marco: CSS test I'll try:
```css
@media (max-width: 380px){
  .peek-handle{width:8px; background: var(--accent); left: env(safe-area-inset-left);} 
  .peek-handle::after{content:''; position:absolute; left:-18px; width:44px; height:44px}
  .table-row[data-h-scroll] .overflow-chevron{transform: translateX(-20px)}
}
```
Marco: JS: add `data-h-scroll` when measuring scrollable containers and hide handle when row action menu is open. Will add graceful fallback for older browsers.
Sam: can we ship the copy tweak independently? Small and reduces confusion.
Elsa: yes, ship copy first. I'll update the design doc with the narrowed handle and chevron shift variant.
edgebot: ci note — added mobile-overlap e2e to staging (build 2026.06.01-05).
Marco: opening WIP PR: https://git.redwood/PR/4991 (handle + chevron shift WIP). Will add a11y checklist and staging screenshots.
June: I'll run VoiceOver & TalkBack quick passes after staging deploy and verify focus order.
Elsa: scheduling a 10m validation session after PR lands. Thanks team :sparkles:
